event_desc.scheduled_time: Fires at the given time and day.
event_desc.log_match: Fires on a ROSBOT log line that contains the text (case-insensitive).
event_desc.history_match: Fires on a ROSBOT history line that contains the text.
event_desc.error_detected: Fires on an error popup or a log timeout restart.
event_desc.death_detected: Fires when the log or the plugin reports a death (once per 15 seconds).
event_desc.fail_detected: Fires when the log reports a failed run.
event_desc.d3_launch: Fires when D3 is detected running (also when monitoring starts with D3 open).
event_desc.d3_exit: Fires when D3 is detected not running.
event_desc.monitoring_start: Fires when monitoring (the ROSBOT flow) starts.
event_desc.monitoring_stop: Fires when monitoring (the ROSBOT flow) stops.
event_desc.log_rollover: Fires when ROSBOT rolls its log file (logs.txt.1 appears).
event_desc.history_rollover: Fires when ROSBOT rolls its history file (history.txt.1 appears).
event_desc.log_timer: Fires once when the log has no new line for the given seconds; a new line re-arms it.
event_desc.history_timer: Fires once when the history has no new line for the given minutes; a new line re-arms it.
event_desc.new_run: Fires when ROSBOT starts a new run (INFO - Running).
event_desc.combat_switch: Fires every second (paused during pylon buffs); pair it with "Game speed" to switch factors by combat state.
event_desc.urshi_open: Fires when the greater rift gem upgrade dialog opens (keep D3 at 16:9; tune the gem thresholds when it does not fire).
event_desc.town_portal: Fires while the town portal is channeled; in-game windows over the portrait block it.
event_desc.town_portal_v2: Fires on town portal, not while a hostile illusion is unfinished (not 100% accurate).
event_desc.shrine_infinite: Fires when a channeling pylon is found; pauses "Combat switch" until the buff ends.
event_desc.shrine_speed: Fires when a speed pylon is found; pauses "Combat switch" until the buff ends.
event_desc.buff_end: Fires when both pylon buffs have ended (duration reached, back in town or new rift).
event_desc.special_portal_timer: Fires when a special portal sequence runs longer than the given seconds, then repeats every that many seconds.
event_desc.inventory_full: Fires when the plugin reports the inventory became full.
event_desc.repair_needed: Fires when the plugin reports gear needs repair.
event_desc.item_pickup: Fires when the plugin records a picked-up item; with text, only when the item or internal name contains it (case-insensitive).

action_desc.write_log: Writes the text to the monitor log.
action_desc.start_monitoring: Starts the ROSBOT flow (ensure Battle.net, start D3 and ROSBOT).
action_desc.stop_monitoring: Stops the ROSBOT flow (ROSBOT keeps running).
action_desc.pause_monitoring: Pauses the flow and, when ROSBOT is botting, pauses it with its pause key (F6); no restarts while paused.
action_desc.resume_monitoring: Resumes a ROSBOT the pause stopped (F6), restarts the log timeout window and continues the flow.
action_desc.stop_bot_f7: Activates D3 and presses F7 to stop ROSBOT (monitoring continues).
action_desc.stop_bot_f9: Activates D3 and presses F9 (monitoring continues).
action_desc.close_bot: Presses F7 twice, 5 seconds apart, to close ROSBOT.
action_desc.restart_bot: Closes D3 and ROSBOT through the flow and starts them again (only while monitoring).
action_desc.restart_bot_battlenet: Same, closing Battle.net first; the flow restarts Battle.net and D3.
action_desc.take_screenshot: Saves the D3 window to the folder (empty uses the default folder).
action_desc.game_speed: Sets the speed factor through the speed bridge by combat state: the plugin's combat flag while it is live, else the ROSBOT cursor color.
action_desc.town_portal: Sends the town portal key to D3 after the delay.
action_desc.quick_quit: Runs the quick quit tool with an optional delay in ms.
action_desc.unstuck_move: Pauses ROSBOT, presses the movement skill and drags mouse circles to get unstuck, then resumes ROSBOT; limited by the interval.
action_desc.execute_command: Runs an external program or command.
action_desc.send_keys: Sends keys to the foreground window (AutoIt Send syntax).
action_desc.notify: Pushes a message through PushPlus / Telegram / Discord / Prowl.
action_desc.set_sequence: Selects the sequence in the ROSBOT sequence list.

rosbot_key.write_before_start: Give ROSBOT the active key (RoS-BoT.ini before start, the KEY dialog when ROSBOT asks)
rosbot_key.add_failed: The key is empty or already in the list.
rosbot_key.restart_ask: ROSBOT is running with another key. Close ROSBOT and start it again with the active key now? (D3 keeps running)
rosbot_key.hint: Keys are stored encrypted. When ROSBOT asks for a key ("Please, enter a key") the active key is filled in and OK is pressed, without the keyboard; ROSBOT then saves it in RoS-BoT.ini. Before every start an existing RoS-BoT.ini gets the active key as Key=.
rosbot_key.result_file_missing: RoS-BoT.ini not created yet (ROSBOT saves it once the key is accepted)
rosbot_key.result_no_anchor: no ROSBOT settings section found in RoS-BoT.ini
